ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We apologize for the frustration. The brand of propane tank is not important, but the condition of the connecting gasket is often responsible for grilling issues. If the LP tank cannot make a secure connection to your grill, your grill's safety "bypass" mechanism will reduce gas flow.

Grill lighting procedure is also crucial. Perform a soapy water leak test to check for leaks. If there is no leak, follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is not only the reset, but how you want to light your grill each and every time.

Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds *Very Important*
Turn the first burner to start/high
Hit your igniter
Turn on remaining burners one at a time and set each to high
Close the lid
Let your grill preheat to 450°F

Our Specialist team is here to help. Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
I am giving it four stars because it's excellent, but this rating may vary depending on individual needs and preferences.

Size: This is my first propane grill (used to charcoal), and we typically grill for 2-3 people at a time. We have it on our balcony, so the size was perfect. However, I must recognize that I underestimated my needs, and perhaps the E-425 (4-burners) would have been a better choice due to its larger cooking area, as well as the additional space for dividing between direct and indirect cooking. 

Power: However, considering power and area, the E-325 appears to be the better option, as it achieves 86 BTU/sq in (according to Weber's website), while the E-425 is slightly lower at 82 BTU/sq in. That is not a big difference, but still, higher is better for searing. Nonetheless, there are some limitations to transitioning between direct and indirect zones.

Assembling it was easy, and it's really easy to use; it heats quickly, and so far, everything has been great.
Results.Title: Think about your needs

Results.ReviewText:
I replaced an older Spirit model that I had for over 15 to 20 years with this new one. I feel that the older model was built much stronger and that is why it lasted so long. I replaced a few parts along the way but it started to rust in areas that I could not repair. I was amazed that the igniter still worked after all those years. I am hoping that we get many years with this new one but it does not feel as sturdy as the old one. 
I have used it now a few times and it works well as far as igniting and heat control. I wish it had a better enclosure as the rain gets into the cabinet area unless I keep the separately purchased cover on it. I will remain hopeful that it lasts a long time and I appreciate that Weber includes a 10 year warranty.
Results.Title: Replaced an old Spirit model
